text:
inc-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate + tail latency spikes observed for cross-region requests eu-west -> apac starting ~1759012000. Customers may see timeouts. Paging oncall.

sara: on it. can someone grab topo + recent routing-policy diffs? @alex @miguel

alex: i'm pulling the routing policy rollouts and recent pin updates now. see recent change: weight shift for eu-west -> apac by autoscale-controller at 1759009800.

miguel: seeing a pattern where latency steering flipped weights in the presence of transient worker OOMs in apac. traffic got pinned to apac by fallthrough policy for some sessions.

lia: customer-facing impact: increases in erroring chat sessions for customers with apac preference, ~12% failure rate per our probe. screenshots incoming.

sara: ok triage plan: 1) stop automatic steering -> set region weight override to balanced, 2) remove any stale pin entries for sessions older than 5m, 3) lower DNS TTL temporarily to accelerate drain. who can run steps 1+2?

alex: i can do 1+2. will patch routing-policy to override and run a quick sweep script to remove pins with age >300s. patching now.

ops-bot: deployment started: routing-policy-override v2 -> canary 1/3

alex: patch applied to canary, logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:05:11Z PATCH /routing/policies/steering
body: {"override": "balanced", "reason": "incident 1759012345"}
200 OK
```

miguel: sweep script to remove stale pins:
```
./scripts/unpin-age.sh --age 300 --region apac --dry-run
# matched 482 pins
./scripts/unpin-age.sh --age 300 --region apac
# removed 482 pins
```

lia: reducing DNS TTL at edge to 30s to speed failover. applying now.

ops-bot: DNS change submitted: ttl set apac-edge 30s -> propagation in progress

sara: good. trigger health-check flood to verify balanced routing and lowered errors.

miguel: running synthetic probes now. initial probes show 50% reduction in tail latency and 60% drop in 5xx within ~90s of the override.

lia: CS note: two major customers reported degraded UX — we've opened tickets and set severity to high. ETA on full mitigation?

sara: if trends continue we'll mark mitigated in 10m, otherwise escalate to infra. @alex if the routing override doesn't stabilize, revert to the previous compatible model and force traffic to NA as temporary fallback.

alex: noted. prepping fallback play:
- set policy to route eu-west pref -> na as fallback
- inform sales/CS

inc-bot: PAGE: oncall escalation to infra -> scheduled 14:30 UTC if not resolved

miguel: one odd thing — some pins persisted despite sweep due to race with session rebinds. adding a short lock step to block rebinds during unpin sweep.

sara: implement the lock and re-run sweep. alex, coordinate with miguel on roll order.

alex: lock deployed, re-run sweep. removed additional 78 pins.

lia: metrics now: 5xx back down to baseline for most customers, a few flows still erroring (legacy SDK). CS will reach out to those customers with workaround (force region param in SDK).

ops-bot: routing-policy-override rollout 100% -> success

sara: thanks everyone. we'll keep monitor for 30m then do postmortem. initial customer impact summary: transient degraded sessions for apac-pref customers (~12% peak), mitigated via override + unpin + ttl change, no data loss.

miguel: filing quick RCA ticket with suspected root cause: steering controller reacted to noisy latency signals during apac worker instability and created aggressive weight flips that left stale pins. follow-ups: add hysteresis to steering logic, ensure unpin sweep atomicity, add guard in SDK for region param.

lia: CS will send consolidated customer communication after PM review.

sara: handing off to night oncall @alex for 14:45 UTC check-in. if anything reappears, escalate to infra immediately. good work :thumbsup:

alex: copy, i'll watch the dashboards and follow up in #eng-runtime if anything spikes.

inc-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. thread pinned to incidents channel.
